thread:
maya: Heads-up: running a compact "webinar + benchmark workshop" next Tue to converge on launch messaging and inbound routing. Need a short playbook so SDRs know how to handle demo vs deep-technical interest. Agenda: 20m benchmark narrative, 20m claim pruning, 20m routing + SDR play scripts. Who's in?

jon: I'll take routing + SLA rules. Thinking we test a simple two-path model: demo -> AE list, deep -> SE rotation. Keep it operationally light.

eli: Two-path is good. Need crystal benchmark framing though: "serving-first economics" vs generic cloud-managed endpoints. Focus on measurable claims.

sara: I'll prepare invite copy and 2 CTAs: product ("Request a demo") and technical ("Book a deep dive"). Also will draft 3 subject lines for A/B.

alex: SDRs want one-sentence scripts. Can you drop both CTAs and short outreach lines here?

maya: CTAs: 1) "Request a demo — predictable latency & cost" 2) "Book a technical deep-dive — perf, kernels & quantization". Alex, want 2 x one-liners?

alex: Yes. Script A (demo): "Thanks for registering — want a 15m demo showing predictable latency?" Script B (deep): "We ran long-context benchmarks — want a technical deep-dive with infra leads?"

jon: Routing: add an `intent` field on the sign-up (`intent=demo` or `intent=deep`) and map via webhook to our CRM lists. Sample minimal rule to test: ```
{"intent":"demo","route":"ae-demo-list","sla_hours":24}
{"intent":"deep","route":"se-eng-rotation","sla_hours":48}
```Keep it simple to avoid routing bugs.

eli: Add fallback if SE capacity is limited: route to a "technical follow-up" queue that gets the recorded session + schedule link. That keeps momentum.

maya: Ops-bot — can you create the Calendly and rehearsal event and post link?

ops-bot: Calendly created: https://calendly.com/redwood/webinar-bench. Rehearsal: Mon 11am PT.

jon: Two conservative slide soundbites to use: 1) "<2x latency vs default managed endpoints at 1k tokens" 2) "~35% lower per-token cost with prefix caching + continuous batching" 10% margin for safety; research to validate.

sara: Subject lines for split test: A) "Webinar: serving-first benchmarks that cut cost" B) "How to make LLM inference predictable at scale" C) "Benchmarked: cost & latency tradeoffs for production LLMs". I'll run sample sends and report.

maya: Action items: jon - implement routing webhook + example JSON; alex - 2-line SDR scripts and inbox templates; sara - invite copy + subject tests; eli - lock benchmark phrasing with research; maya - run claim pruning session. Drop any slide one-liners here by EOD Fri.

eli: Posting two conservative one-liners now for deck use.

alex: I'll seed outreach to 15 priority accounts with the demo script after rehearsal.

maya: Also — make a short FAQ for sales on routing expectations so deep-dive leads don't get lost.

jon: Good call. I'll draft a 5-bullet FAQ and post before the workshop.

ops-bot: Reminder: rehearsal Mon 11am PT. Calendar invite sent.

maya: Thanks team, this should tighten the launch funnel and keep SDRs from overpromising. :thumbsup:
